# PsychologicalImaginationNetwork

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A graph representation of associative links between mental concepts or imagined scenarios, derived from human psychological responses. Offers a biologically grounded topology that can guide the design of neuromorphic memory and associative retrieval circuits.
